senses.definition: A tall plant with large yellow petals and edible seeds that turns toward the sun.

examples.en: She planted sunflowers along the garden fence.
examples.vi: Cô ấy đã trồng hoa hướng dương dọc theo hàng rào vườn.

senses.vi: cây hướng dương; hoa hướng dương

thesaurus.definition: any plant of the genus Helianthus having large flower heads with dark disk florets and showy yellow rays

translations.words: hướng dương; hướng dương quỳ tử; thiên quỳ tử

wiktionary.gloss: Any plant of the genus Helianthus, so called probably from the form and color of its floral head, having the form of a large disk surrounded by yellow ray flowers.
The commonly cultivated species, Helianthus annuus, a native of America.
A bright yellow, like that of the flower petals.
Any flat, radially symmetric organic compound, such as coronene.
Synonym of worm-star.

An Automatic Warning System (AWS) indicator in the driver's cab that is displayed after a driver has acknowledged an audible warning, which consists of a yellow circle enclosing a white circle, with black spokes overlaid.

tatoeba.en: If I were a flower, I would be a sunflower.
tatoeba.vi: Nếu là hoa, tôi sẽ là hoa hướng dương.

blocks.etymology: Alteration of earlier lean as a rake, from Middle English lene as a rake; the last element in is potentially an modification of either Middle English *rak (“skinny animal”) (from Old Norse hrak) or rak (“rack”) after rake (“rake”), though it might merely represent that word.

wiktionary.gloss: Incredibly thin; at an unhealthy-looking level of thinness.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English tissu, from Old French tissu (“woven”), past participle of tistre (“to weave”), from Latin texō (“to weave”).

senses.definition: Soft thin paper used for blowing your nose or wrapping delicate things, or a single sheet of it.

examples.en: She took a tissue from the box to wipe her tears.
examples.vi: Cô ấy lấy một tờ khăn giấy từ hộp để lau nước mắt.

examples.en: The fragile gift was carefully wrapped in white tissue.
examples.vi: Món quà dễ vỡ đã được gói cẩn thận trong giấy lụa trắng.

senses.vi: khăn giấy; giấy ăn; giấy lụa

senses.definition: A collection of similar biological cells that work together to perform a particular task in living things.

examples.en: Exercise increases the flow of oxygen to muscle tissue.
examples.vi: Tập thể dục làm tăng lượng oxy truyền đến mô cơ.

examples.en: The scientist studied the damaged plant tissue under a microscope.
examples.vi: Nhà khoa học đã nghiên cứu mô thực vật bị tổn thương dưới kính hiển vi.

senses.definition: A large and connected group of lies or invented stories presented as the truth.

examples.en: His entire explanation turned out to be a tissue of lies.
examples.vi: Toàn bộ lời giải thích của anh ta hóa ra là một mớ dối trá.

thesaurus.definition: part of an organism consisting of an aggregate of cells having a similar structure and function
a soft thin (usually translucent) paper

vi_block: Mớ, tràng, dây (chuyện nói láo, chuyện vô lý... ).
Giấy lụa, khăn giấy; đồng nghĩa với tissue-paper.

wiktionary.gloss: Thin, woven, gauzelike fabric.
A fine transparent silk material, used for veils, etc.; specifically, cloth interwoven with gold or silver threads, or embossed with figures.
A sheet of absorbent paper, especially one that is made to be used as tissue paper, toilet paper or a handkerchief.
Absorbent paper as material.
A group of cells (along with their extracellular matrix if any) that are similar in origin and function together to perform a specific job.

examples: a tissue of forgeries, or of lies
wiktionary.gloss: Web; texture; complicated fabrication; connected series.
The scratch sheet or racing form.
A cigarette paper.
Anything that is light, thin, and delicate.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English tissu, from Old French tissu (“woven”), past participle of tistre (“to weave”), from Latin texō (“to weave”).

thesaurus.definition: create a piece of cloth by interlacing strands of fabric, such as wool or cotton

wiktionary.gloss: To form tissue of; to interweave.
To have the contents of an injection or intravenous drip leak into the tissue as a result of a ruptured or punctured vein.

examples: If you stay out in the rain, you will get wet through.
